script: LeBron James is so old that people forget that Taj Gibson is still an active NBA player. Taj Gibson is only a few months younger than LeBron James. They're both 41 years old as of this upload. Taj is the second oldest active NBA player in the league today. Taj played with Cameron Bairstow and back in the day, he was teammates with Cameron's dad, Carlos Boozer. Despite being nearly the same age as LeBron, LeBron did not join the NBA at the same time. LeBron of course was drafted in 2003, but Taj didn't join until the 2009-10 season, reason being, Fleming can explain it. I went to college. Last season, Taj played 10 games for the Grizzlies averaging 3.4 points and 9.7 minutes per game. So currently he has more of a Udonis Haslem type role for the franchise, aka a coach in a player's uniform. But it's still crazy to see him in the league after all these years, which is a huge accomplishment. It's also crazy to see LeBron James who's 41 and still playing like a top 10 active NBA player. One of my favorite Taj Gibson facts is that he is one of the only players in NBA history to wear number 67, having chosen it as a tribute to his hometown neighborhood of Fort Greene, Brooklyn. You're wondering who the other 67 player is, it's Smokey Becker who played for the Detroit Falcons in 1947.
